entries.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
entries.description: The Bot User OAuth Token of the business's own Slack app, installed with read scopes only. The connector reads messages and threads in the channels the bot is invited to, and stops if the token holds any other scope, such as chat:write.
howToGet: At api.slack.com/apps, create a new app from scratch in the business's own workspace and don't distribute it, so it keeps Slack's internal-app limits.

Under OAuth & Permissions > Bot Token Scopes, add exactly channels:read and channels:history, and groups:read and groups:history if private channels should be read. Add nothing else: no chat:write, users:read or files:read.
Install the app to the workspace, copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-) straight into the host's secret store, then invite the bot (/invite @app-name) to each channel it should read.

entries.name: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET
entries.description: Verifies Events API deliveries Slack sends to this instance (X-Slack-Signature). Optional: the instance doesn't take Slack webhooks yet, and the scheduled sync reads the same messages.
howToGet: At api.slack.com/apps, open the app > Basic Information > App Credentials, and copy the Signing Secret straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: SLACK_TEXT_CHANNELS
entries.description: Which channels keep their message text: none (the default) keeps who posted, when and where but no text; all keeps text from every channel the bot is in; or a comma-separated list of channel ids. Kept text has email addresses, phone numbers, other numbers of seven or more digits, link paths and people's names taken out.
howToGet: Leave empty for none. To keep text, open each channel in Slack, click its name and copy the Channel ID at the bottom of the About tab, then list the ids separated by commas.

entries.name: SLACK_APP_DISTRIBUTION
entries.description: How the Slack app is distributed, which sets how fast history can be read: internal (the default), an app made in the business's own workspace, may read about 50 pages a minute; non_marketplace, an app installed from outside that isn't in the Slack Marketplace, may read 1 page of 15 messages a minute since May 2025.
howToGet: Leave empty for internal. Set non_marketplace only if the app was installed from another workspace and isn't listed in the Slack Marketplace.
